name: Capy Night
desc_en:
Say goodnight, and a capybara settles in for the night in a cozy attic. Wake up, check in, and see how
you slept.

Capy Night is a bedtime and wake check-in companion. No missions to fight through when you wake — one
tap before bed, one tap when you're up, and that's the whole loop.

CHECK IN
- One tap to start tonight, one tap to check in when you wake
- A ±30 minute wake window, not a single hard minute
- A single quiet local notification wakes you — it doesn't repeat, and it isn't waiting to catch you
  oversleeping

COLLECT
- Every on-time wake opens one gift: an attic item, or a few coins toward one you want
- 40 items across four zones — bed, window, shelf, floor
- A 7-day streak adds a coin bonus on top of the normal gift

LOOK BACK
- A monthly calendar of every check-in: on time in green, overslept in red
- Tap any recorded night to see when you went to bed, when you woke, and how long you slept

CAPY NIGHT PRO
- 15 attic items only Pro can place
- Multi-stage bedtime reminders — 30 minutes before, 10 minutes before, and at bedtime itself
- Annual or one-time lifetime. Everything else in the app is free forever.

Works offline. No account. Nothing leaves your phone.
desc_ko:
잘 자라고 인사하면 카피바라가 다락방에서 밤을 보냅니다. 아침에 일어나 체크인하고, 얼마나 잤는지
확인하세요.

Capy Night는 취침과 기상 체크인을 돕는 앱입니다. 깨어날 때 씨름할 미션 같은 건 없어요. 자기 전에 한
번, 일어나서 한 번, 그게 전부입니다.

체크인
- 오늘 밤 시작에 한 번, 기상 체크인에 한 번
- 정확히 한 순간이 아니라 ±30분의 기상 체크인 창
- 조용한 로컬 알림 하나가 깨워줍니다. 반복되지 않고, 늦잠을 잡아내려 기다리지도 않아요

수집
- 정시에 일어날 때마다 선물 상자가 하나 열립니다: 다락방 소품이거나, 원하는 소품을 살 코인 몇 개
- 침대·창가·선반·바닥 네 자리에 걸친 소품 40개
- 7일 연속 달성하면 평소 선물에 코인 보너스가 더해집니다

돌아보기
- 모든 체크인을 담은 월간 캘린더: 정시는 초록, 늦잠은 빨강
- 기록된 밤을 탭하면 취침 시각, 기상 시각, 수면 시간을 볼 수 있어요

Capy Night 프로
- 프로만 놓을 수 있는 다락방 소품 15개
- 다단계 취침 알림 — 30분 전, 10분 전, 취침 시각 정각
- 연간 또는 평생 1회 결제. 나머지는 전부 계속 무료입니다.

오프라인으로 작동합니다. 계정이 없고, 아무것도 기기 밖으로 나가지 않아요.
promo_en: A capybara settles into an attic for the night. Say goodnight, and it wakes you gently in the morning. Check in, see how you slept, and decorate with what you find.
promo_ko: 카피바라가 다락방에서 밤을 보냅니다. 잘 준비를 마치면 아침에 부드럽게 깨워줘요. 체크인하고 얼마나 잤는지 보고, 찾은 소품으로 다락방을 꾸며보세요.
notes:
Capy Night needs no account and no login. Everything is reachable from a cold launch.

How to see the paid features:
1. Two routes, both reachable without a purchase: Home (gear icon, top right) > the "Capy Night Pro" row; or the Room screen (tap the scene from Home) > any Pro-badged item, which opens the paywall on tap.
2. The paywall lists two products: Capy Night Pro Annual (auto-renewing, 1 year) and Capy Night Pro Lifetime (non-consumable). Price, period, auto-renewal and how to cancel are shown on that screen, with Terms of Use and Privacy Policy links beside them.
3. Restore Purchases is the text button under the two plans.

How to see a full night's check-in without waiting until real morning:
1. From Home, tap the gear icon (top right) to open Settings, then tap "기상 시각" ("Wake time") and set it to a few minutes from now — for example, if the device clock reads 2:00 PM, set 2:15 PM. Anything under 30 minutes ahead works; set it at least two minutes ahead of the device clock, so it is still in the future when "눕기" is tapped in step 2. (Do this whole walk on one side of 6 PM device time rather than straddling it — which night a check-in files under is decided by the moment "눕기" is tapped next, not by the wake time — and if anything about the result looks off, simply repeating from this step corrects it.)
2. Go back to Home and tap "잘 준비" ("Get ready for bed"), then "눕기" ("Lie down") on the sheet that opens — the system notification-permission dialog appears next; tap "Allow". If "Don't Allow" instead, tap "알림 없이 눕기" ("Lie down without notifications") on the sheet and continue identically. This starts tonight's check-in against the wake time just set, with a fixed ±30 minute window around it (that width is a rule, not a setting), and pushes a full-screen "sleeping" view showing the wake time.
3. Because the saved wake time is within 30 minutes of now, the window is already open the moment that view appears — it shows both "일어났어" ("I'm up") and "취소" ("Cancel") right away, no waiting. Tap "일어났어" — this runs the actual check-in and opens the reward screen. ("취소" abandons tonight's night — use it only to restart from step 1 if this screen never shows "일어났어" (which means the wake time chosen in step 1 had already passed when "눕기" was tapped). If the wake time were further out but still ahead of now, this same screen would show only the wake time and "취소" until the window opened, then grow the "일어났어" button on its own — no need to leave the screen or relaunch the app either way.)

The app makes no network calls at all. All data is a local SQLite database, which is why the App Privacy answer is Data Not Collected.
